taskNotes: Shades are assigned by Mazchna with no Slayer level requirement (combat level 30 needed); the wiki also lists Vannaka (40-90) but only the Mazchna assignment is authored per the C3 starter-tier worklist scope, with Vannaka documented here for honesty.
slayerTargetId 302 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
Shades are undead: the salve amulet and Crumble Undead apply. Loar Shades in Mort'ton are the fastest kill; Priest in Peril is required for Mort'ton access.
Loar Shade (default) has 38 Hitpoints, max hit 4 (Crush), 4-tick attack speed, and Defence level 26 with all defensive bonuses 0.
Loar and Catacombs Shades have a 40% weakness to wind spells; Wind Bolt does more damage than Crumble Undead for the same chaos rune at 35+ Magic.

Phrin, Riyl, Asyn, Fiyr and Urium Shades in the Shade Catacombs also count toward the task; only Loar, Catacombs-of-Kourend and Stronghold shades are authored with full stats here (others honest UNKNOWN).
No task extension unlock exists for Shades.
recommendedMethod: Kill Loar Shades in Mort'ton (Priest in Peril required) for the fastest completion. Shades are undead, so wear a salve amulet (e) and use melee for the quickest kills; the 40% wind weakness makes Wind Bolt a strong Magic option (better than Crumble Undead per chaos rune at 35+ Magic). The level-140 Shades in the Catacombs of Kourend are a safespottable, higher-Slayer-XP alternative. Avoid the Stronghold of Security shades, whose combat and Slayer XP are drastically reduced.
